description: Common docker run knobs for the containers of one role.

fields.description: --restart. Benchmarks want a crash to be visible, not silently restarted: the default is no.
fields.name: restart_policy
fields.title: Restart policy

fields.description: Retry count appended to on-failure (--restart on-failure:N). Ignored for other policies.
fields.name: restart_max_retries
fields.title: Restart retries

fields.description: --log-driver. json-file is what the agent tails to ship container logs.
fields.name: log_driver
fields.title: Log driver

fields.description: --log-opt max-size: rotate a log file at this size (k/m/g suffix).
fields.name: log_max_size
fields.title: Log max size

fields.description: --log-opt max-file: number of rotated files kept.
fields.name: log_max_file
fields.title: Log files kept

fields.description: --ulimit nofile soft limit: open file descriptors per process.
fields.name: ulimit_nofile_soft
fields.title: nofile (soft)

fields.description: --ulimit nofile hard limit.
fields.name: ulimit_nofile_hard
fields.title: nofile (hard)

fields.description: --ulimit nproc: max processes/threads. 0 leaves the daemon default.
fields.name: ulimit_nproc
fields.title: nproc

fields.description: --ulimit memlock in bytes; -1 = unlimited (needed when the engine locks its buffer pool).
fields.name: ulimit_memlock
fields.title: memlock

fields.description: --shm-size. PostgreSQL parallel query and pg_stat need more than the 64 MB default.
fields.name: shm_size_mb
fields.title: /dev/shm size

fields.description: --pids-limit; -1 = unlimited.
fields.name: pids_limit
fields.title: PID limit

fields.description: Emit --cpus from the machine size chosen for this role instead of letting the container use the whole host.
fields.name: limit_cpu
fields.title: Limit CPU to the machine size

fields.description: Emit --memory from the machine size chosen for this role.
fields.name: limit_memory
fields.title: Limit memory to the machine size

fields.description: --cpus value. Filled by the server from the role's machine size when limit_cpu is on.
fields.name: cpus
fields.title: CPUs

fields.description: --memory value. Filled by the server from the role's machine size when limit_memory is on.
fields.name: memory_mb
fields.title: Memory limit

fields.description: --privileged. Needed only for engines that touch raw block devices (YDB pdisks).
fields.name: privileged
fields.title: Privileged

fields.description: --network. host removes the NAT hop and is what the product uses for database roles.
fields.name: network_mode
fields.title: Network mode

fields.description: --add-host entries "name:ip". Filled by the server from topology so peers resolve without DNS.
fields.name: extra_hosts
fields.title: Extra hosts

fields.description: --sysctl key=value, applied inside the container namespace (net.* only when network_mode is bridge).
fields.name: sysctls
fields.title: Container sysctls

fields.description: --cap-add. IPC_LOCK for engines that mlock memory, SYS_NICE for scheduler priority.
fields.name: cap_add
fields.title: Capabilities

computed.expr:
(root.limit_cpu && ("cpus" in root) ? " --cpus " + string(root.cpus) : "") +
				 (root.limit_memory && ("memory_mb" in root) ? " --memory " + string(root.memory_mb) + "m" : "")

" --ulimit nofile=" + string(root.ulimit_nofile_soft) + ":" + string(root.ulimit_nofile_hard) +
				 (root.ulimit_nproc > 0 ? " --ulimit nproc=" + string(root.ulimit_nproc) : "") +
				 " --ulimit memlock=" + string(root.ulimit_memlock) + ":" + string(root.ulimit_memlock)

root.log_driver == "none"
					? "--log-driver none"
					: "--log-driver " + root.log_driver +
					  " --log-opt max-size=" + root.log_max_size +
					  " --log-opt max-file=" + string(root.log_max_file)

rules.message: nofile soft limit must be <= hard limit
net.* container sysctls require network_mode = bridge (host mode shares the host namespace)
